title: neopallasia yunnanensis

It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
